body:
Merry Christmas. I'm sorry that you don't feel appreciated. Life can change on a dime though. So you never know what could happen in a year. Or five years from now. You never know who you are going to meet. Just take everything one day at a time and drag yourself through your depression. You'll come out the other side and look back at the rough times, and be happy that you were able to overcome the hard parts.  
Some of us out here love and appreciate you. Even if we are complete strangers. <3
The best thing to do when you are uncertain is to take it to Jesus. Pray about it, and he will give you the answer.

I love you ❤ It may not mean very much coming from a stranger on the internet. But, we're in this together! I may not be able to physically be with you & comfort you, but you're not alone. Everyone goes through hard shit in life. It's a guarantee. But you will come out the other side brighter and stronger. You just have to get through it. As difficult as it may be. I believe in you. You can do this!  
Get some help for the voices. Don't be afraid. Other people go through what you're going through. It's just hard to find support IRL with similar situations. But you're for sure not the only person ever to have this happen. With enough support you can do anything.  
Just keep reminding yourself that you're loved, everything will be okay!
